intro.en: I am an undergraduate in Information Security at the School of Computer Science, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, and a member of the Zhiyuan Honors Program. I am currently a research intern at MemTensor, mentored by Juncheng Zhang (Tsinghua University). Previously, I worked with Prof. Xuanhe Zhou at Theseus Lab.
intro.zh: 我目前就读于上海交通大学计算机学院信息安全专业，是致远荣誉计划成员。目前在 MemTensor 担任研究实习生，导师为 Juncheng Zhang（清华大学）；此前在 Theseus Lab 跟随周煊赫教授开展研究。

intro.en: My research began with database systems and data management, studying how large language models interact with structured data and heterogeneous databases. This led me to approach memory as a data-management problem: how agents represent, store, retrieve, update, and maintain experience. In Are We Ready For An Agent-Native Memory System?, I explored these questions through system decomposition and systematic evaluation.
intro.zh: 我的研究始于数据库系统与数据管理，关注大语言模型如何与结构化数据及异构数据库交互。这段经历让我开始将记忆视为一个数据管理问题：智能体应如何表示、存储、检索、更新和维护经验？在 Are We Ready For An Agent-Native Memory System? 中，我通过系统模块划分与系统性评测探索了这些问题。

intro.en: Building on this foundation, I now focus on coding foundation models, long-horizon agents, and memory for self-improving AI. At MemTensor, I work on coding-model post-training and memory mechanisms for long-horizon coding agents. I am especially interested in how external and parametric memory help models and agents accumulate, consolidate, and reuse experience over long-term interaction.
intro.zh: 在此基础上，我目前关注代码基础模型、长程智能体，以及服务于自我改进 AI 的记忆机制。在 MemTensor，我参与代码模型后训练，并研究长程代码智能体的记忆机制。我尤其关注外部记忆与参数记忆如何帮助模型和智能体在长期交互中积累、整合和复用经验。

publications.title: MemTrace: State-Consistent Memory for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
publications.image_alt: MemTrace overview: execution history becomes immutable memory traces, which are aligned with the evolving repository and checked before reuse.

summary.en: Memory that stays aligned with changing code. MemTrace treats long-horizon coding memory as a state–memory alignment problem. Immutable Memory Traces carry explicit repository provenance; a Memory Trace Graph (MTG), a Repository State Graph (RSG), and trace-to-entity bindings connect execution history to the current repository so historical evidence can be validated before reuse.
summary.zh: 让记忆与持续变化的代码保持一致。MemTrace 将长程代码智能体的记忆建模为状态与记忆的对齐问题。不可变的 Memory Traces 保存明确的仓库来源信息；Memory Trace Graph（MTG）、Repository State Graph（RSG）及轨迹与实体间的绑定，将执行历史关联到当前仓库，以便在复用历史证据前验证其有效性。

highlights.en: Evaluated on DeepSWE, SWE-EVO, and SWE-Milestone under two coding-agent harnesses with the same backbone model; improved the primary metric over Native memory in every completed benchmark × harness setting.
highlights.zh: 在相同基础模型下，基于两种代码智能体框架评测 DeepSWE、SWE-EVO 和 SWE-Milestone；在已完成的各组基准与框架组合中，主要指标均优于对应的 Native 记忆策略。

highlights.en: 57.0% of file-bound Memory Traces were exposed to later repository modifications, motivating explicit checks of historical evidence against the current state.
highlights.zh: 57.0% 的文件关联 Memory Traces 所对应的文件在后续执行中发生过修改，说明有必要依据当前状态检查历史证据。

contributions.en: Led the design and development of MemTrace, including structured execution traces, repository-state grounding, and validation before memory reuse.
contributions.zh: 主导 MemTrace 的设计与开发，包括结构化执行轨迹、仓库状态关联，以及记忆复用前的有效性验证。

contributions.en: Studied the interaction between persistent execution history and evolving repository state, and evaluated the system against native memory strategies.
contributions.zh: 研究持久化执行历史与演化中的仓库状态之间的关系，并开展与原生记忆策略的对照评测。

publications.title: Dial: A Knowledge-Grounded Dialect-Specific NL2SQL System

role.zh: 共同第一作者 · 列第二

publications.image_alt: Dial framework: dialect-aware logical planning and adaptive query refinement grounded in a hierarchical dialect knowledge base.

summary.en: Knowledge-grounded NL2SQL across database dialects. Dial addresses differences in SQL syntax, functions, and execution constraints. It combines natural-language logical query plans (NL-LQP) and dialect-sensitive intermediate representations with retrieval from HINT-KB, iterative execution feedback, and semantic correction.
summary.zh: 面向异构数据库方言的知识增强 NL2SQL。Dial 针对不同 SQL 方言的语法、函数与执行约束差异，结合自然语言逻辑查询计划（NL-LQP）、方言敏感的中间表示、HINT-KB 知识检索、迭代执行反馈与语义修正。

contributions.en: Contributed to natural-language request preprocessing and NL-LQP / dialect-aware logical planning, supporting semantic decomposition from requests to logical plans.
contributions.zh: 参与自然语言请求预处理与 NL-LQP / 方言感知逻辑规划，支持从用户请求到逻辑计划的语义分解。

contributions.en: Worked on dialect-sensitive intermediate representations, operator annotation, and knowledge retrieval for date, string, and type-conversion semantics.
contributions.zh: 参与方言敏感的中间表示、算子标注，以及面向日期、字符串、类型转换等易错语义的知识检索。

contributions.en: Participated in HINT-KB design and initialization, dataset preparation, multi-round feedback, semantic correction, failure analysis, and rebuttal revisions.
contributions.zh: 参与 HINT-KB 设计与初始化、数据集准备、多轮反馈生成、语义修正、失败分析及 rebuttal 修改。

publications.title: Are We Ready For An Agent-Native Memory System?
publications.image_alt: Four representative agent memory workflows: streaming logs, hierarchical tiers, knowledge graphs, and hybrid multi-engine memory systems.

figure_caption.zh: 图 1 · 智能体记忆工作流

summary.en: Agent memory through a data-management lens. This study decomposes memory into representation and storage, extraction, retrieval and routing, and maintenance. We compare heterogeneous architectures on task effectiveness, retrieval fidelity, robustness to dynamic updates, long-horizon stability, and runtime cost.
summary.zh: 从数据管理视角理解智能体记忆。这项工作将记忆系统划分为表示与存储、提取、检索与路由、维护四类模块，并从任务效果、检索保真度、动态更新鲁棒性、长程稳定性和运行成本等方面比较异构记忆架构。

contributions.en: Participated in decomposing memory systems into representation and storage, extraction, retrieval/routing, and maintenance modules.
contributions.zh: 参与将记忆系统划分为表示与存储、提取、检索与路由、维护等核心模块。

contributions.en: Contributed to systematic evaluation of task effectiveness, retrieval fidelity, update robustness, long-horizon stability, and runtime cost.
contributions.zh: 参与任务效果、检索保真度、更新鲁棒性、长程稳定性与运行成本的系统性评测。

contributions.en: Analyzed where memory architectures succeed or fail across conversational QA, factual recall, temporal reasoning, and long-running scenarios.
contributions.zh: 参与分析不同记忆架构在对话问答、事实回忆、时序推理与长期运行场景中的表现及适用条件。

additional_publication.title: Tensor-Network Physical Pages for Quantum-Ready Data Management

summary.en: TN-Page explores tensor-network physical-page representations for approximate data management and data-loading abstractions targeting quantum backends.
summary.zh: TN-Page 探索面向近似数据管理的张量网络物理页表示，以及面向量子后端的数据加载抽象。

contributions.en: Contributed to workload-aware bucketization, semantic tensorization, tensor-network factorization, and backend-aware encoding.
contributions.zh: 参与工作负载感知分桶、语义张量化、张量网络分解与后端感知编码。

contributions.en: Helped organize evaluation around fidelity, compression, qubit usage, and gate depth.
contributions.zh: 参与围绕保真度、压缩率、量子比特使用量与门深度组织评测。

details.en: Contribute to coding-oriented post-training of the 284B-parameter DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 model: synthesize software-engineering tasks, curate and filter training data and execution trajectories, and evaluate checkpoints on coding and repository-level tasks.
